my-role-2030.title: My role in 2030
my-role-2030.purpose: How your role changes by 2030 and 2035: drivers, tasks, skills added, a bridge curriculum and your time to get ready.

my-role-2030-tasks.title: What the tool will do, what you will still own
my-role-2030-tasks.purpose: Every task of a role in three bands with the AI capability reason, and the skills that complement AI.

careers-role-transformation.title: Role transformation
careers-role-transformation.purpose: A public summary of how a role is expected to change, without numbers.

workforce-transformation.title: Role transformation overview
workforce-transformation.purpose: All role transformation maps, readiness for the 2030 profiles and task exposure by family, suppressed under 10 people.

workforce-transformation-edit.title: Edit role transformation map
workforce-transformation-edit.purpose: Edit, check and publish a role transformation map.

my-transition-plan.title: My transition plan
my-transition-plan.purpose: Your plan while your role changes: the role kept for you, your retraining, the practice that protects your ladder, and review dates. Only you and HR see it.

workforce-transition-plans.title: Transition plans
workforce-transition-plans.purpose: HR board of transition plans (SIMULATED HR records): protected roles, retraining, ladder-rung practice and review dates.

workforce-transition-plan.title: Transition plan
workforce-transition-plan.purpose: One transition plan: edit, record reviews, complete or withdraw.

workforce-rung-alerts.title: Ladder-rung alerts
workforce-rung-alerts.purpose: Mastery Builder roles whose junior tasks move to tools, and the simulator and OJT practice training plans must add.

planning.title: Planning assumption, no deployment decision implied
planning.body: Role maps, 2030 and 2035 profiles and the timeline are planning assumptions for learning. They imply no deployment decision, no headcount and no site. Task ratings use a simulated AI capability reference on the OECD scale.

my.intro: How your role is expected to change by 2030 and 2035, what stays with people, which skills come in, and how long it takes you to get ready from your own skills.
my.noAccess: Role transformation maps are for staff.
my.noRoleBody: Your profile has no current role. Pick any current role to explore its map and see your time-to-ready for it.
my.askDalil: Ask Dalil about my role in 2030
my.askQ: How will my role change by 2030?

tiles.growSub: Stay with people; their share grows
tiles.augmentedSub: AI assists; you own the outcome
tiles.shrinkSub: Parts move to tools; you verify

work.title: How the work moves
work.desc: From the task layer of the SAT workbench: each rated task compared with a simulated AI capability reference at its change horizon. Open "Why this?" for the reason.
work.none: No task-level analysis for this role yet
work.noneBody: Training staff have not rated this role's tasks in the SAT workbench yet. The skills added and the bridge curriculum below still apply.

bandHint.augment: What the tool will do: draft, check, summarise. What you still own: the decision and the result.
bandHint.automate_partly: What the tool will do: routine parts end to end. What you still own: verifying, and acting when it is wrong.
bandHint.human_core: What you still own: all of it. AI capability does not reach what the task needs.

added.title: Skills added
added.desc: What the 2030 profile asks for that today's does not, and what 2035 adds again (published role profiles).

bridge.title: Bridge curriculum
bridge.none: Nothing to bridge: the profile does not change.
bridge.practice: Guided practice (no short course in the catalogue yet)
bridge.note: One step per skill added. A short course (staff, not initial qualification training, 80 hours or less) when the catalogue has one; otherwise guided practice at 20 hours per level.

gaps.title: My time-to-ready for {h}
gaps.noMe: Sign in as a staff member to see your own gaps.
gaps.readyBody: Your current skill states meet every requirement of this profile.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.desc: Dated milestones with their sources. Planning gates are simulated for the demo.

pathOnly.title: Career-path level only
pathOnly.body: Security, safeguards and cyber roles are shown at career-path level only. Task and skill detail stays outside Kafa'a.

tx.intro: Every task of a role in one of three bands, each with the reason behind it: what the tool will do, and what you will still own. It helps you decide what to learn; it is not a score of you.
tx.principleBody: We describe how tasks move between people and tools. Every band shows the capability comparison behind it, and the people who do the work stay accountable for it.
tx.refLabel: Tasks AI can assist or partly automate in this role ({n} rated)
tx.refNote: The Singapore figure uses a different method across many sectors; it is a reference line, not a target.
tx.compDesc: The skills behind the human-core tasks of this role: they grow in value as tools take on routine work.
tx.compTasks: Needed by {n} human-core tasks, up to level {level}
tx.compProfile: From the 2030 profile, level {level} (no task analysis yet)

pub.title: {role}: how the role changes
pub.intro: A public summary of how this role is expected to change. Signed-in staff also see the tasks, the skills and their own time to get ready.
pub.noMap: No published map for this role yet.
pub.none: No new skills at this horizon.

wf.intro: Every role's transformation map, how ready people are for their role's 2030 profile, and task exposure by family. People counts and shares under 10 people are suppressed.
wf.hrOnlyBody: People aggregates are for the HR analyst and the HR director.
wf.tileMapsSub: Current roles with a published map
wf.tileDriversSub: Distinct drivers named in the maps
wf.readyDesc: For staff in current roles: how many already meet every requirement of their role's profile at the horizon, and the median time to get there from their own skills (2 months per level of gap).
wf.medianTitle: Median months to {h}-ready by family group
wf.expDesc: Rated tasks of each person's role, counted once per person, so the mix shows where people's work moves. People in roles without task analysis are counted but add no tasks.
wf.suppressNote: Groups under {n} people are suppressed: no count and no share is shown.
wf.notBroken: Security, safeguards and cyber families are never broken out.

ed.intro: Edit the map, check it against the publishing rules as you type, save a draft or publish it.
ed.readOnlyBody: Only the training manager and the HR director edit role transformation maps.
ed.pathBody: This role stays at career-path level: no archetype and no drivers. Only the summaries can change.
ed.checkDraftOk: Ready to save as a draft
ed.rule: Describe how tasks change, not people.
ed.confirmBody: The public summary becomes visible to everyone, staff see the new map at once, the previous version moves to the history, and the action is recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS evidence ledger.

code.invalid: Choose an archetype and known drivers; summaries 40 to 700 characters, public summaries 20 to 320, in English and Arabic
code.security_restricted: Security, safeguards and cyber roles stay at career-path level: no archetype and no drivers
code.unclean_text: Remove headcount, site or deployment wording
code.banned_wording: Describe how tasks change, not people: some wording is not used (English and Arabic)
code.public_numbers: The public summary carries no numbers
code.source_required: Publishing needs at least one https source with a label

reasons.move_grow: Human core: AI capability does not reach what this task needs, so it stays with people and its share of the role grows
reasons.move_augmented: AI-assisted: the tool helps, and a person keeps ownership of the outcome
reasons.move_shrink: Partly automatable: parts of the task move to tools and a person verifies the result, so time on it shrinks
reasons.driver_robotics: Driven by robotics and remote inspection
reasons.driver_smr_design: Driven by SMR and advanced-reactor design (no deployment decision implied)
reasons.complement_tasks: Needed by {n} human-core tasks of this role, up to level {level}
reasons.complement_profile: A human or transversal skill the {horizon} profile asks for at level {level}
reasons.bridge_course: Shortest short course in the catalogue that teaches this skill ({hours} h)
reasons.bridge_practice: No short course yet: guided practice, {levels} levels x {per} h = {hours} h
reasons.gap: You are at level {have}; the profile asks for {need} (gap {gap})
reasons.time_ready: You already meet every requirement of the {horizon} profile
reasons.time_rule: {levels} levels of gap x {per} months per level = about {months} months (the Career Navigator's estimate)
reasons.time_gaps: Based on {n} gaps in {of} requirements, from your own skill states
reasons.copy_rule: SkillsFuture Singapore shows AI potential per task as what the tool will do and what people still own; corporate reskilling programmes pair honest change signals with a personal path. Kafa'a describes how tasks move between people and tools.
reasons.opt_sim: Approved simulator scenario for the {position} position that trains {overlap} competencies this task needs ({minutes} min)
reasons.opt_ojt_own: OJT repetitions of this task's own qualification-card task ({reps} suggested), acknowledged by a preceptor
reasons.opt_ojt_sibling: No qualification-card task for this one: OJT on a task of the same role that stays with people and shares {shared} skills ({reps} repetitions suggested)
reasons.rung_task_below: A junior task of a rung below on the career ladder: people used to build judgement on it
reasons.rung_task_own: A routine task of this role, not a critical one
reasons.rung_covered: The plan adds {n} practice items for it
reasons.rung_uncovered: No practice in the plan yet
reasons.rung_mastery: Mastery Builder role (SkillsFuture archetype on its published FS11 map): skill grows step by step on the job
reasons.rung_not_mastery: Not a Mastery Builder role, so no ladder-rung alert applies
reasons.rung_no_role: Neither the target nor the protected role is a Mastery Builder role
reasons.rung_tasks: {n} junior tasks from this role and {rungs} rungs below move to tools by {horizon} (FS06)
reasons.rung_none: No junior task moves to tools by {horizon} (FS06)
reasons.rung_role_target: The alert is about the target role, where the person is building judgement
reasons.rung_role_protected: The target role is not a Mastery Builder role, so the alert is about the protected role the person still works in

tp.conceptNote: The target is a concept role for planning only: no deployment decision implied.

privacy.title: Who sees this plan
privacy.me: Only you and HR (the CHCO office) see this plan. Your line manager does not, whatever their scope.
privacy.hr: Plans are visible to the person and to HR only. Managers, the training manager and HR analysts never see a plan; training managers see role-level ladder-rung alerts with no person.

tp.practiceToAdd: Practice a training plan must add
tp.noAlertBody: This role is not a Mastery Builder role, so its judgement does not depend on junior tasks that tools take on.
tp.noAlertNone: Neither the target nor the protected role is a Mastery Builder role, so no ladder-rung alert applies.
tp.alertOpen: Ladder-rung alert: {n} junior tasks have no practice yet
tp.alertOpenBody: Add simulator or OJT practice for every task below before the plan can be activated.
tp.alertCovered: Ladder protected: practice added for all {n} junior tasks
tp.alertCoveredBody: Each task that moves to tools keeps the judgement it built through the synthetic practice named below.
tp.alertNone: No junior task moves to tools by this horizon
tp.alertNoneBody: The FS06 task layer shows no junior task of this Mastery Builder role becoming partly automatable by {h}.

my.intro: A transition plan is made when your role is changing. It keeps your current role protected while you retrain, sets the target role and the reviews, and, for Mastery Builder roles, adds the practice that keeps your judgement when junior tasks move to tools.
my.noneBody: HR opens a plan with you when your role is changing. You can see how your role changes by 2030 on My role in 2030.
my.ackBody: You confirm that you have read the plan with HR. This is recorded once in the audit trail; it does not change the plan.
my.alertDesc: The junior tasks of your Mastery Builder role that move to tools, and the simulator runs and OJT repetitions in your plan.

tile.ojtSub: Acknowledged by a preceptor since the plan started

hr.intro: Transition plans for people whose role is changing (SIMULATED HR records, no HR system connected). A plan becomes active only when every ladder-rung task has practice and the reviews are at most six months apart.
hr.noAccess: Transition plans are for HR (the CHCO office) only

ed.eyebrow: SIMULATED HR record · nothing is saved until you confirm
ed.protectedHint: The person's current role, kept for them while they retrain
ed.reviewsHint: At least one review date, in order, at most {n} days apart from the start and from each other.
ed.fromBridge: Start from the FS11 bridge curriculum
ed.alertHint: Tick the simulator scenarios or OJT tasks that keep the judgement each junior task built. Every alerted task needs at least one before activation.
ed.draftOnly: Can be saved as a draft; not ready to activate: {why}
ed.ready: Ready: the plan can be activated.
ed.saveActiveBody: The active plan is updated; its done reviews are kept. Audited.
ed.activateBody: The plan becomes active: the person is notified and can acknowledge it, the NEXUS ledger records the activation, and only the person and HR can see it.
ed.saveDraftBody: The draft is saved for HR only; the person sees it as a draft.
ed.activated: Plan activated; the person is notified

err.self_plan: You cannot decide your own transition plan.
err.open_plan_exists: This person already has an open plan.
err.invalid_role: Choose a target role different from the protected role.
err.invalid_trigger: Choose why the role is changing.
err.invalid_dates: Check the dates: the plan ends after it starts, and the role stays protected until a date within the plan.
err.reviews_required: Plans carry review dates: 1 to 12, in order, within the plan, at most 183 days apart.
err.invalid_retraining: Each retraining step needs a kind, English and Arabic titles, 1 to 400 hours and a due date within the plan; a course step names a course.
err.invalid_practice: Practice must be an eligible simulator scenario or OJT task for an alerted task.
err.banned_wording: Describe how tasks change, not people: the copy check refuses wording that frames people as no longer needed.
err.retraining_required: An active plan needs at least one retraining step.
err.rung_practice_required: Every junior task in the ladder-rung alert needs simulator or OJT practice.
err.no_review_due: No review is due yet (from 14 days before its date).

plan.intro: One transition plan (SIMULATED HR record). HR edits it, records the reviews and closes it; the person acknowledges it.
plan.notFound: Plan not found, or not visible to you
plan.alertDesc: The junior tasks of the plan's Mastery Builder role that move to tools, with the practice added and the person's acknowledged OJT repetitions.
plan.completeBody: The plan is completed: the person is notified and the NEXUS ledger records it.
plan.withdrawBody: The plan is withdrawn: the person is notified and the NEXUS ledger records it.
plan.nextNeeded: Required: no review date is left after this one
plan.nextOptional: Optional: adds a review after the last one

ra.intro: Mastery Builder roles grow judgement step by step on the job. When the FS06 task layer shows their junior tasks moving to tools, training plans must add synthetic practice so that people still build that judgement. This view names no person.
ra.note: Task bands come from the FS06 planning assumptions (SIMULATED AI capability levels). Simulator scenarios are metadata only; no scenario content is shown.
